title: Symphony to Present 'Jingle All The Way' on December 20th - NewsBreak
text:
By Jennifer Lopez ,
15 hours ago On December 20th, the Big Spring Symphony Orchestra will present Jingle All the Way! – A Community Holiday Celebration under the direction of Dr. Fagner Magrinelli Rocha. This exciting holiday performance will be at 5:30 PM at the Big Spring Municipal Auditorium with the doors opening by 5 PM. Come share the joy of the holidays at this beloved Big Spring tradition! Jingle All the Way! is a festive musical celebration that brings together the Big Spring Symphony with talented singers from Howard College, the Big Spring Community Chorale and Runnels Academy. The combined Symphony Chorale has been practicing for several months with Choir Director, Mark Watt. Enjoy favorite seasonal melodies, joyful carols and symphonic classics that capture the warmth and magic of this special time of year. With a heartwarming blend of nostalgia, community, and cheer, this concert is a magical holiday experience that is perfect for the whole family. Let the music lift your spirits and ring in the season with your Big Spring Symphony. Read full article
